ReportRelation.ReportRelationExpression: Left join vwdb_Item on vwdb_Sales_SumQty.ItemID = vwdb_Item.ItemID
Left join vwdb_Customer on vwdb_Sales_SumQty.CustomerID = vwdb_Customer.CustomerID
Left join vwdb_Location on vwdb_Sales_SumQty.LocationID = vwdb_Location.LocationID
Left join vwdb_Users on vwdb_Sales_SumQty.RequesterID = vwdb_Users.UserID
Left join vwdb_Transporter on vwdb_Sales_SumQty.TransporterID = vwdb_Transporter.TransporterID
inner join tblCompany on vwdb_Sales_SumQty.CompanyID = tblCompany.CompanyID
Left join vwdb_TaxCategory on vwdb_Sales_SumQty.TaxCategoryID = vwdb_TaxCategory.TaxCategoryID
Left join vwdb_DSR on vwdb_Sales_SumQty.DSRID = vwdb_DSR.DSRID
Left join vwdb_CompanyUnit on vwdb_Sales_SumQty.CompanyUnitID = vwdb_CompanyUnit.CompanyUnitID
